text:
zoe: Orion (HW partner) asked for a private marketplace offer bundling a 12mo commit + an appliance rebate voucher. They want a coordinated announcement in ~6 weeks. Can partnerships sketch pricing, voucher flow, and renewal terms?

mike: Sales: propose starting commit $150k/year. Ladder: 18% -> 24% + $20k voucher -> 30% + $45k voucher at top tier. Term 12mo auto-renew w/60d opt-out. Include a 60-day POC ramp credit up to $10k.

sanjay: Finance: vouchers treated as subsidy (contra-revenue) and amortized over 12mo. If sales wants upfront invoice reduction, need reconciliation and CAF. Also require clawback if commit not met.

claire: Legal: ok but vouchers must have expiry (90 days from issue), non-transferable, and recoupable on failure to reach commit. Also need partner logo approval for joint announcement.

zoe: Ops: how is voucher redeemed? two options: 1) marketplace shows net price and applies voucher (requires partner integration), or 2) voucher redeemed off-marketplace via partner portal and shown as separate line on PO. Ops prefers option 2 to avoid marketplace flow changes.

mike: field prefers net price display for procurement clarity. If ops insists on off-marketplace redemption, include a clear line-item note and estimated net savings.

sanjay: compromise: display gross price and add "Estimated voucher" metadata field. Accounting will record voucher separately to keep ARR clean.

claire: i'll prepare PO addendum text with voucher expiry and clawback. Also draft a short joint announcement checklist for partner approvals.

zoe: timeline: publish preview private-offer in staging 1 week before public announce; require SI runbook link before final publish. i'll coordinate partner approvals and schedule the announcement slot. tagging @mike @sanjay @claire.

acct-bot: Reminder: review window for po-ORION-1750012345 opens in 48h.
